title: Hold an authority to enter or use a marine park
what: Enter or use a Queensland marine park for a purpose that needs an authority (such as a commercial activity) only under that authority.

sources.title: Marine Parks Act 2004 (Qld)
sources.quote: If this Act requires a person to obtain an authority to enter or use a marine park for a particular purpose, a person must not wilfully enter or use the park for the purpose without the authority

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Marine Parks Act 2004 (Qld)
